# FlowCondition { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowCondition }

```python
timelines.FlowCondition(passes=None, after=None, _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any]())
```

When a destination is taken, or a Break ends the flow.

The value of a Break's ``ends``, and the part a :class:`JumpDestination`
shares with it. Every condition stated must hold.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| passes | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[int](`int`), ...\] \| [PassesFrom](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.PassesFrom`) \| None | The arrivals of the flow at the element that count: distinct positive integers (the n-th arrival is pass n), or :class:`PassesFrom`. On a Break the passes listed are exactly those arrivals. Among the destinations of a Jump, the one naming the highest number any of them lists also holds at every later arrival (the last ending is played again after a D.C.). |
| after  | [DestinationReference](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.DestinationReference`) \| None                      | A destination of another Jump: the condition holds once that destination has been taken, and is used up when it has served.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.FlowCondition.to_dict }

```python
timelines.FlowCondition.to_dict(minimal=True)
```

Return the condition as its JSON object.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default   |
|---------|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| minimal | [bool](`bool`) | Write the minimal form (the default): every key at its default value left out. With False, the complete form: the keys that have a default (``determined``, ``reset`` and ``label`` of a destination) are written whatever they hold. A key without a default is written only when stated. | `True`    |
